description: A PHP class for managing site delivery limitations based on channels, including methods for initialization, display, and compilation of limitations, as well as related functions for sorting channels.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Site_Channel
classes.description: A PHP class for filtering ad delivery based on site channels, supporting multiple comparison operators and rendering HTML for channel selection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and sets the English name for the delivery rule set.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the object with data and sets up operations for comparison.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed in the current context, excluding 'channel-acl.php'.

methods.name: displayArrayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML for displaying and selecting channels associated with a banner.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates a string representing the compiled limitations based on selected channels and comparison operator.
